svg.title: Two hands ready to go out
svg.desc: First hand: three melds of three cards and a loose card, the 5 of diamonds, which goes to the discards. Second hand: a run of five spades and a set of four Kings, with no card left over.
svg.text: Two hands ready to go out
Three melds and one card to discard
The coloured bars show the melds, as in the app. Cards are only revealed when you go out.
Melds need not have 3 cards: 3 + 3 + 3, 5 + 4, 4 + 5 and so on are all fine.
